subject: reasoning
question: GMRW is related to TNID in a certain way based on a certain relationship between the given letters in the English alphabetical order. In the same way, AJQV is related to ZQJE. Which of the given options is ITZB related to following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Opposite letter according to English alphabetic series.

​​So,

 
• GMRW is related to TNID

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af82cb296e79f4e1d08ea4bf9315e5f6fc54499cfcca497461759e87e220ae64.png] 

​And,

 
• AJQV is related to ZQJE

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c54191cf9edf750ee4825fa29808a4e12cacfdab69bdb64e35d717178fac6a22.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ITZB is related to ?

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81142b9f9500a9cbe443b9e914e569ce46e0220dcedfb9f6ff3f5b7db3c52dbc.png] 

Hence, "**RGAY**" is the correct answer.
